description: Accepted cases record exact canonical UTF-8 text and content_hash = 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical bytes)). Rejected cases contain exactly one defect and record its error code and JSON Pointer path. schema_valid records whether the JSON Schema alone accepts the input (null when the text is not strict JSON); semantic rules beyond JSON Schema are listed in x-crc-rules.
